summary: Fix confirmed. With tokenizer.json truncation max_length 4096, the repository's Tokenizer at the fix parent 203db0c3bfeb encoded a ~10000-token text to 4096 tokens, and get_default_calibration(100 rows x 2048 columns) returned 14 empty (0-token) rows: the two split_raw sources requested 11 + 7 rows and each yielded only 2 full 2048-token rows, matching the ledger's count. At the fix f8b9ab72ae9f (truncation disabled) the same text encoded to 10001 tokens and all 100 rows were 2048 wide.
what_ran: repro.py copies the Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct fixture (weights symlinked), adds a 4096-token truncation block to tokenizer.json, builds Tokenizer.from_config(Config.from_directory(...)) and calls exllamav3.conversion.calibration_data.get_default_calibration with cal_rows 100, cal_cols 2048. Environment py311-81fd62ef04f7-torch26cu126. No GPU needed. The ledger records no affected commit other than via the fix, so only the fix pair was run.
limits: Calibration data only; a full conversion with the short rows was not run, so downstream effects (e.g. failures on empty rows) were not observed.
modifications: Fixture only: the copied tokenizer.json gains a truncation block with max_length 4096. Upstream is not modified.
